literal: of the eye pallor? sorrow has attained indeed bright forehead what was done having seen
translation: Has the pallor of my eyes grown sorrowful upon seeing what my bright forehead has done?
modern: ஒளிபொருந்திய நெற்றி பசலையடைந்து செய்ததைக் கண்டு, என் கண்களின் பசலையும் துன்பம் அடைந்துவிட்டதோ?
explanation: The heroine laments the physical toll of her separation from her lover. She notices that her bright forehead has lost its beauty and turned pale. Seeing this, she wonders if the pallor in her eyes has also grown sorrowful out of sympathy for her forehead. The poet uses the personification of the eyes' pallor feeling sorrow to emphasize the spreading nature of her grief and physical wasting.
